messages:
rachel_cs: Heads-up: Harbor Systems (HB-9) renewal landed. Customer requests 9-month term (instead of 12) and Net-60. Procurement also asked to split billing between Harbor UK and Harbor EU and include customer-managed KMS. Need quick confirmation from legal + finance before we send DocuSign.

 tom_fin: Do we have PO or intent to pay? if it's net-60 that increases AR risk. send PO pls. finance needs VAT registration for EU entity before we issue EU invoice.

 rachel_cs: PO: HB-PO-9901 attached in the portal. Procurement wrote "split 65/35 UK/EU" and attached an EU VAT cert pdf. They say master SOW can be signed by UK entity only.

 ivy_legal: that's workable but ask procurement to confirm indemnity boundaries. if UK signs master but EU is billed, we need an addendum carving out EU-specific liabilities and tax obligations. i'll draft language.

 devops_enable: FYI enablement scheduled week-of-6/7. if billing holds beyond 6/1 we may need to push training one week. we'll prepare acceptance checklist regardless.

 tom_fin: VAT cert looks valid. i'll provision vendor code once legal approves addendum. also flagging that KMS onboarding requires IAM access window; we'll need ARN + contact.

 ivy_legal: drafting addendum now: includes invoice split clause, KMS responsibilities (customer provides key ARN and rotates keys), and signature options (single sig with addendum vs dual sig). sending to rachel for review.

 rachel_cs: thanks ivy. i'll send addendum draft to Harbor procurement and request confirmation on signatory authority for EU entity. tagging procurement contact: jane@harbor.com.

 docu-sign-bot: DocuSign envelope 'Harbor_SOW_Addendum_v1' created and awaiting attachments: 'VAT_cert_EU', 'PO_HB-PO-9901'.

 tom_fin: once signed we can generate two invoices. mark account health: yellow until EU liability confirmed.

 rachel_cs: noted. i'll update renewal risk and escalate to AM if no sign-off by Thu COB. will post updates here.
